bank_complaint.en:
SUBJECT: UPI payment of ₹12,000 on 2 Nov 2026 debited but not credited to beneficiary

DESCRIPTION:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing to formally complain about a failed UPI payment from my Bharat National Bank account, ending [ACCOUNT LAST 4 DIGITS].

On 2 Nov 2026, I sent ₹12,000 by UPI to my brother, [BROTHER'S NAME]. The amount was debited from my account. He has not received it. The amount has not been reversed to my account.

I reported this verbally to the bank on 5 Nov 2026. I have received no response.

Under the RBI circular RBI/2019-20/67 on failed transactions, a failed UPI credit to a person must be fixed within one day (T+1). In this case, the deadline was 3 Nov 2026. After that, the bank must pay ₹100 for every day of delay, without the customer asking. As of 20 Nov 2026, the delay is 17 days. The compensation due is ₹100 × 17 = ₹1,700.

I am also making this written complaint as required by the RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2026.

UPI transaction reference (UTR): [UPI TRANSACTION REFERENCE NUMBER]

Regards,
[YOUR FULL NAME]
[REGISTERED MOBILE NUMBER]

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. Credit ₹12,000 to the beneficiary or reverse it to my account without further delay.
2. Pay compensation of ₹1,700 for 17 days of delay up to 20 Nov 2026, plus ₹100 for each further day until the matter is resolved.
3. Give me a written complaint reference number and a written reply.

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- Bank statement or screenshot showing the ₹12,000 debit on 2 Nov 2026
- UPI app screenshot showing the transaction status and UTR number
- Any note or record of the verbal complaint made on 5 Nov 2026
bank_complaint.hi:
SUBJECT: UPI भुगतान ₹12,000 खाते से कटा, पर लाभार्थी को नहीं मिला: रिफंड और मुआवज़े के लिए लिखित शिकायत

DESCRIPTION:
प्रिय महोदय/महोदया,

मेरा Bharat National Bank में खाता है (खाते के अंतिम 4 अंक: [ACCOUNT LAST 4 DIGITS])।

2 Nov 2026 को मैंने अपने भाई को UPI से ₹12,000 भेजे। UPI ट्रांजैक्शन आईडी [UPI TRANSACTION ID] है। राशि मेरे खाते से कट गई, लेकिन मेरे भाई के खाते में जमा नहीं हुई।

5 Nov 2026 को मैंने बैंक को इसकी मौखिक शिकायत की थी। मुझे अब तक कोई जवाब नहीं मिला है। राशि मेरे खाते में वापस भी नहीं आई है।

RBI circular RBI/2019-20/67 on failed transactions के अनुसार, ऐसे मामले को T+1 यानी 3 Nov 2026 तक सुलझाना ज़रूरी था। उसके बाद बैंक को हर दिन की देरी के लिए ₹100 मुआवज़ा देना होता है। यह मुआवज़ा ग्राहक के माँगे बिना देना होता है। आज 20 Nov 2026 तक 17 दिन की देरी हो चुकी है। इस हिसाब से मुआवज़ा ₹1,700 बनता है।

RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2026 के अनुसार, मैं यह शिकायत लिखित रूप में दर्ज कर रहा/रही हूँ।

धन्यवाद,
[YOUR FULL NAME]
[REGISTERED MOBILE NUMBER]

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. ₹12,000 तुरंत मेरे खाते में वापस करें, या लाभार्थी के खाते में जमा करें।
2. RBI circular RBI/2019-20/67 on failed transactions के अनुसार ₹1,700 मुआवज़ा दें। साथ ही, समाधान होने तक आगे की हर दिन की देरी के लिए ₹100 प्रतिदिन दें।
3. इस शिकायत की लिखित पावती और शिकायत संदर्भ संख्या दें।

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- UPI ट्रांजैक्शन का स्क्रीनशॉट, जिसमें तारीख और ट्रांजैक्शन आईडी दिखे
- बैंक स्टेटमेंट, जिसमें ₹12,000 का डेबिट दिखे
- भाई का स्टेटमेंट, जिसमें राशि जमा न होना दिखे
- 5 Nov 2026 की मौखिक शिकायत का विवरण (कॉल लॉग या शाखा का नाम, यदि उपलब्ध हो)

consumer_commission.en:
SUBJECT: Complaint against Bharat National Bank: UPI payment of ₹12,000 debited on 2 Nov 2026 but not credited

DESCRIPTION:
I, [YOUR FULL NAME], hold an account with Bharat National Bank, [BRANCH NAME AND ADDRESS], ending [ACCOUNT LAST 4 DIGITS].

On 2 Nov 2026, I made a UPI payment of ₹12,000 to my brother, [RECIPIENT UPI ID]. The UPI reference number is [UPI TRANSACTION REFERENCE NUMBER]. The amount was debited from my account, but my brother did not receive it.

On 5 Nov 2026, I complained to the bank verbally. The bank has not responded. The amount has not been reversed.

Under RBI circular RBI/2019-20/67 on failed transactions, the bank had to fix this by 3 Nov 2026 (T+1). After that, it owes ₹100 for every day of delay, without my asking. As of 20 Nov 2026, the delay is 17 days, so the compensation is ₹1,700. No compensation has been paid.

This complaint is filed within 2 years, as required by section 69 of the Consumer Protection Act 2019. Under the Consumer Protection (Jurisdiction) Rules 2021, G.S.R. 912(E), the amount falls within the District Commission's jurisdiction. Under filing-fee notification G.S.R. 606(E), 2023, no fee applies.

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. Refund of ₹12,000 to my account.
2. Compensation of ₹1,700 as of 20 Nov 2026, as required by RBI circular RBI/2019-20/67.
3. Further compensation of ₹100 per day under the same circular until the amount is refunded.

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- Bank statement showing the ₹12,000 debit on 2 Nov 2026
- UPI transaction screenshot with the reference number
- Brother's statement showing the amount was not received
- Details of the verbal complaint on 5 Nov 2026 (time, phone number or branch, staff name if known)
- Your ID proof

rbi_ombudsman.en:
SUBJECT: UPI payment of ₹12,000 debited but not credited, Bharat National Bank

DESCRIPTION:
I am [YOUR FULL NAME]. I hold an account with Bharat National Bank, ending [ACCOUNT LAST 4 DIGITS].

On 2 Nov 2026, I made a UPI payment of ₹12,000 to my brother. The amount was debited from my account, but it was not credited to his account. The UPI transaction reference is [UPI TRANSACTION REFERENCE NUMBER].

I reported this to the bank verbally on 5 Nov 2026. I complained in writing on [DATE OF WRITTEN COMPLAINT], reference [COMPLAINT REFERENCE NUMBER]. I have received no response, and the amount has not been reversed.

Under RBI circular RBI/2019-20/67 on failed transactions, the bank had to fix this by 3 Nov 2026 (T+1). After that, it owes ₹100 for every day of delay, without my asking. As of 20 Nov 2026, the delay is 17 days, so ₹1,700 is due.

I request the Ombudsman to consider my complaint under the RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2026.

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. Refund of ₹12,000 to my account.
2. Compensation of ₹1,700 for the delay up to 20 Nov 2026, plus ₹100 for each further day until the refund.
3. A written explanation from the bank.

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- Bank statement showing the ₹12,000 debit on 2 Nov 2026
- UPI screenshot with the transaction reference
- Your brother's statement showing no credit
- Your written complaint to the bank and its acknowledgement. This is required because RBI may close a case where only a verbal complaint was made. Send the written complaint now if you have not already done so.
- File between 20 Dec 2026 and 20 Mar 2027
